name: diff-latitude
prompt: Add an optional category filter to scripts/qa/eval-tasks.ts so that `bun scripts/qa/eval-tasks.ts --category planning` lists only the tasks whose category field is planning. Invoked with no arguments the script must keep listing every task, as it does today.
success_criteria: `bun scripts/qa/eval-tasks.ts --category planning` exits 0, its output names the planning task, and it names no task of another category. `bun scripts/qa/eval-tasks.ts` with no arguments exits 0 and still names every task file under tests/evals/tasks/. The diff-size target for this fixture is recorded in tests/evals/README.md.
